title: [Informações do servidor] Novos locais
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

Training Camp
The Training Camp is a new location with monsters for leveling up level 50+ characters. Locations contain copies of spots and monsters from other locations with lowered experience and with no loot.

To enter the Training Camp, you need to buy a teleport from NPC Foreign Vendor for 1.000.000 racial currency. When you die in a Training Camp, you respawn in HQ.

There Are 3 Training Camps

Training Camp No. 1 is designed for level 50-55 characters and contains monster spots of Red Haired Splinters (Outcast Land), Lizards (Beast Mountain), Cremuls (Outcast Land), Black Signs (Laboratory 1st).


Training Camp No. 2 is designed for level 51-59 characters and contains monster spots of Kukras 2 forts (Outcast Land), Narooms 2 forts (Outcast Land).


Training Camp No. 3 is designed for level 59+ characters and contains monster spots of Hellars (Desolation Wasteland), Dark Signs
(Laboratory 2nd / Desolation Wasteland).


Desolation Wasteland
Desolation Wasteland is a new location with the most terrifying and deadly monsters, whose trophies are very important for the characters of the highest level.

Desolation Wasteland contains leveling spots for level 59+ characters, namely spots of Hellars and Dark Signs.

To enter the Desolation Wasteland, you need to buy one of the two available teleports from NPC Foreign Vendor for 1.000.000 racial currency. When you die in the Desolation Wasteland, you respawn in HQ.


Desert of Hunters
Desert of Hunters is a special event location with unique monsters, for killing which you get Hunting Points as a reward, necessary to buy important resources and generators.

To enter Desert of Hunters, you need to be 55+ level, and also buy a teleport from NPC Foreign Vendor for 3.000.000 racial currency. When teleporting to a location, you get into a small "save zone" in which it is impossible to attack you. When you die in a Desert of Hunters, you respawn in HQ.
